name: Basic settings
descr: The base settings of the shop: the tree of the codes and the values every code keeps - the lists the whole program picks from, from the kind of a goods to the style of a section. The tree of the codes belongs to the platform and is only read; the values are what this tool writes. A value marked sys_key is one the platform relies on by its very name: its text may be changed, but not that name, and it cannot be removed.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the whole registry - the tree of the codes and every value standing under them, two tables in one answer. The tree itself belongs to the platform and is read here, never written.

commands.name: CmdValueAdd
commands.descr: Adds a value to a code, at the end of its list.

params.name: key_code
params.descr: the code of the list it goes into

params.name: key_name
params.descr: the name of the value, the word the shop keeps in its rows

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text a person reads instead of that word

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdValueUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of values, by id. The text of a value the platform relies on (sys_key) may be changed; its name may not.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the value, or several of them

params.name: key_name
params.descr: the name of the value, the word the shop keeps in its rows

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text a person reads instead of that word

commands.name: CmdValueRemove
commands.descr: Deletes values by id. What already holds such a value keeps the word: nothing of the shop is rewritten behind it. A value the platform relies on (sys_key) is refused.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the value, or several of them

commands.name: CmdValuePos
commands.descr: Lays the values of one code in order.

params.name: key_code
params.descr: the code whose values are put in order

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT
